definitions.gloss: station name; the name of a railway station
definitions.explanation: The official name of a train or subway station, as shown on platform signs, route maps, and in announcements.

examples.japanese: {駅名|えきめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確|たし}かめる→確かめる：01955_tashikameru⟧。
⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{駅名|えきめい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧そうだ。
examples.english: I hear the station name will change from next year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{地名|ちめい}→地名：04059_chimei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦そのまま→そのまま：03322_sonomama⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧{駅名|えきめい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{近|ちか}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧や⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{付|つ}く→付く：01960_tsuku⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Many station names simply use the local place name, but sometimes the name of a nearby school or temple is used.

notes:
⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧ (station) + {名|めい} (name). The {名|めい} suffix forms this whole family of words: ⟦{地名|ちめい}→地名：04059_chimei⟧ (place name), {社名|しゃめい} (company name), {書名|しょめい} (book title).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {駅名|えきめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確|たし}かめる→確かめる：01955_tashikameru⟧: to check the station name
- {駅名|えきめい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧: the station name changes
- {駅名|えきめい}{標|ひょう}: station name sign (on the platform)
- {駅名|えきめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}み{上|あ}げる→読み上げる：04604_yomiageru⟧: to read out the station names

CULTURAL NOTE:
Station renaming is a small but regular news item in Japan, and companies sometimes pay for a station to carry their name. Because station names double as informal neighborhood names, a change affects addresses in conversation too.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{地名|ちめい}→地名：04059_chimei⟧: place name — the wider term; a station name often comes from one
- {路線名|ろせんめい}: line name — the name of the railway line rather than the stop
